verdict.rationale: LiveKit's SIP-based telephony stack lets agents make/receive calls via inbound and outbound SIP trunks, which is the standard mechanism for bringing your own carrier or PBX (docs-26, docs-32, gh-2, docs-31). This is architecture-agnostic SIP, not a bundled/proprietary telephony lock-in, satisfying the platform-engineer's need to connect external trunks. Missing for 10: explicit documented walkthroughs or examples of importing Twilio/Telnyx numbers specifically, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of a real carrier trunk connection succeeding.
